YEARS 2 AND 3 FOCUS ON EXPANDING IMPLEMENTATION OF CONSERVATION PRACTICES, INCREASING THE NUMBER OF LANDOWNERS READY FOR NRCS CONTRACTING, AND SCALING WATERSHED-LEVEL WORK THROUGH CULTURALLY ROOTED PARTNERSHIPS SUCH AS PUERTO RICAN COMMUNITY FORESTS, FLORIDA’S RANCHING SYSTEMS, AND NEW MEXICO’S ACEQUIA ASSOCIATIONS.
